title: Matt Haley
description: "l always wondered what Luke was thinking in this scene," reflects Matt Haley. "He's respecting his nemesis and saying good-bye to his father. That's what makes Luke a hero, not all the space battles." A relative newcomer to comics, Matt Haley got his start penciling STAR TREK: THE NEXT GENERATION (DC) and PHANTOM or FEAR CITY (Claypool), as well as BRIGADE (Image), the forthcoming GHOST special (Dark Horse) and CADILLACS AND DINOSAURS (Topps). He's very pleased that Shepherd Hendrix, inker on Bernie Wrightson's CAPTAIN STERNN (Kitchen Sink) was kind enough to ink this card.
